event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 101 and 84
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,519 parameters at 99.070000%, a +0.070000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 70 prior macro-attempts in this family and 622 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0172/micro-0020 at 1,520 parameters and 99.12%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0171/micro-0013 (FF-output pair 236/180 discarded at 98.98%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 101 and 84, values 0.0158948060 and 0.0167777501 (difference 8.829e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,518 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 8.938e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
